memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus.” (Philippians 2:5)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Everybody today wants to become a mastermind  a genius, a trendsetter, a record breaker. Even in spiritual circles, many desire positions, leadership titles, importance, and visibility on the stage. They want to be noticed and appreciated. They want to shine more than they want to serve.
But very few choose a different and holy path — the hidden path where one waits before God, away from noise, seeking not brilliance but the Master’s Mind, the mind of Jesus.
The Word of God commands us to clothe ourselves with the mind of Christ.  Look at Jesus:
He humbled Himself though He is the Most High.
He walked gently though He is the King of kings. He obeyed fully though He held all authority. He made Himself nothing though everything was created through Him. He never sought fame, spotlight, or recognition. He lived only to do His Father’s will  not His own.
This is the Master’s Mind  a mind that chooses nothingness, servanthood, obedience, and surrender.
But today we see many chasing fame, leadership, spiritual importance, and visibility. This fame seeking spirit is one of Satan’s sweetest traps.
His goal is always to shift our eyes from God to ourselves.
Let us therefore stay away from this snare.
Let us choose Christ’s humility over worldly mastery.
Let us seek the Master’s Mind rather than becoming a mastermind in the world.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “True greatness is not found in exaltation, but in descending to serve.” A.W. Tozer

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, give me Your mind a humble, obedient, surrendered heart. Remove every desire for fame and worldly greatness. Make me a servant who reflects only You. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the gentle mind of Christ guide your thoughts today. May His humility lift you into true greatness in God’s sight.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: The Pursuit of God
recommended_book.author: A.W. Tozer
recommended_book.quote: The sinner prides himself on his independence, completely overlooking the fact that he is the weak slave of the sins that rule his members. The man who surrenders to Christ exchanges a cruel slave driver for a kind and gentle Master whose yoke is easy and whose burden is light.
